data

[object]

A list of RUM retention filters.

attributes

object

The object describing attributes of a RUM retention filter.

cross_product_sampling

object

The configuration for cross-product retention filters.

session_replay_enabled

boolean

Whether the cross-product retention filter for Session Replay is enabled.

session_replay_sample_rate

double

The sample rate for the Session Replay cross-product retention filter, between 0 and 100.

trace_enabled

boolean

Whether the cross-product retention filter for APM traces is enabled.

trace_sample_rate

double

The sample rate for the APM cross-product retention filter, between 0 and 100. Values returned by the API are rounded to two decimal places.

enabled

boolean

Whether the retention filter is enabled.

event_type

enum

The type of RUM events to filter on. Allowed enum values: session,view,action,error,resource,long_task,vital,operation,execution_context

name

string

The name of a RUM retention filter.

query

string

The query string for a RUM retention filter.

sample_rate

double

The sample rate for a RUM retention filter, between 0.1 and 100. Values are truncated to one decimal place.

track

enum

The product track a RUM retention filter applies to. Allowed enum values: rum,product_analytics

id

string

ID of retention filter in UUID.

meta

object

Metadata about a RUM retention filter.

edition_mode

enum

Which attributes of the retention filter can be edited. complete: all attributes can be edited. limited: only the sample rates can be edited; the name, event type, and query are fixed and the filter cannot be reordered (for example, default filters). unknown: the edition mode is not set. Allowed enum values: unknown,complete,limited

source

enum

The source of the last change to a RUM retention filter. Allowed enum values: default,ui,terraform,unknown

updated_at

int64

The timestamp of the last update to the retention filter, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

updated_by_handle

string

The handle of the user who last updated the retention filter.

type

enum

The type of the resource. The value should always be retention_filters. Allowed enum values: retention_filters

default: retention_filters
